title: Leopold the First
html_source:
There was a Leopold the First in Belgium

Leopold I (French: Léopold Ier, German and Dutch: Leopold I; Coburg, 1790 – Laeken, 1865) was a German prince who became the first King of the Belgians following Belgian independence in 1830. He reigned between July 1831 and December 1865.
